skill.name: triage
skill.description: Guide maintainers through issue and external PR triage, from classification to verification, comments, and agent-ready briefs.
skill.summary: Guides maintainers through structured issue and external PR triage.
skill.author: mattpocock

security_audit.summary: The static analyzer findings are false positives caused by Markdown inline code, fenced examples, and ordinary prose. The skill still carries high contextual risk because it handles external PRs, instructs agents to check out code, and can run verification commands. Maintainer approval and sandboxed verification are needed before issue tracker mutations or external PR command execution.

remediation.issue: External PR verification can execute untrusted contributor code.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit maintainer approval before checking out external PRs or running tests. Review the diff first and use a sandboxed environment for commands.

remediation.issue: External issue and PR text can contain prompt injection.
remediation.suggestion: Add instructions that issue bodies, comments, PR descriptions, and diffs are untrusted content and must not override system or maintainer instructions.

remediation.issue: The workflow can change issue tracker state and repository documentation.
remediation.suggestion: Show the exact labels, comments, closures, and file changes before acting, then wait for maintainer confirmation.

semantic_findings.title: Untrusted PR Verification Can Execute Contributor Code
semantic_findings.description: SKILL.md includes external PRs in triage and tells the agent to check out a PR, then run relevant tests or commands. Running project commands after checking out external contributor code can execute untrusted code.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The instructions explicitly cover external PRs and direct checkout plus command execution for verification. This is a clear security risk when the PR author is untrusted.

semantic_findings.title: Untrusted Issue Content Is Read Without Injection Guardrails
semantic_findings.description: SKILL.md tells the agent to read issue and PR bodies, comments, labels, authors, dates, and diffs. Those surfaces can contain prompt injection, but the skill does not warn the agent to treat reporter content as untrusted.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The skill is designed to consume external issue and PR text, and no local guardrail tells the agent to ignore instructions embedded in that content. The finding is contextual, not based on an observed injection string.

semantic_findings.title: Issue Tracker and Repository State Mutation
semantic_findings.description: The workflow tells the agent to apply roles, post comments, close issues, and create or update .out-of-scope files after triage outcomes. These actions mutate public tracker state and repository files, so they need explicit maintainer approval.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The cited workflow explicitly lists state-changing actions, including comments, closes, labels, and file writes. The risk is operational misuse rather than hidden malicious code.

content.value_statement: Issue queues become stale when labels, context, and next actions are unclear. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through structured triage.
actual_capabilities: Lists unlabeled, needs-triage, and reactivated needs-info items for maintainer attention.
Classifies issues and external PRs as bug or enhancement requests.
Recommends state roles such as needs-info, ready-for-agent, ready-for-human, or wontfix.
Writes agent briefs with current behavior, desired behavior, key interfaces, acceptance criteria, and scope boundaries.
Records rejected enhancement requests in .out-of-scope documentation when the maintainer confirms the decision.
Adds a required AI-generated disclaimer to issue tracker comments.
limitations: Requires an issue tracker configuration and label mapping before acting.
Needs maintainer approval for normal recommendations and unusual state transitions.
External PR verification may require local checkout and project-specific test commands.
Does not replace maintainer judgment for product direction or feature rejection.

use_cases.title: Prioritize Incoming Reports
use_cases.description: Review unlabeled, needs-triage, and answered needs-info items so maintainers can choose the next issue to handle.

use_cases.title: Prepare Agent-Ready Work
use_cases.description: Turn a verified issue or PR into a durable brief with acceptance criteria and clear scope boundaries.

use_cases.title: Preserve Rejection Decisions
use_cases.description: Document rejected enhancement requests in .out-of-scope files so repeated requests can be handled consistently.

prompt_templates.title: Review My Queue
prompt_templates.prompt: /triage Show me issues and external PRs that need my attention. Group them by triage state and sort oldest first.

prompt_templates.title: Triage One Issue
prompt_templates.prompt: /triage Review #42. Summarize the report, recommend a category and state, and wait for my direction.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Agent Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: /triage Move #42 toward ready-for-agent. Verify the claim, identify missing details, and draft the agent brief for review.

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate External PR
prompt_templates.prompt: /triage Review PR #118 as an external contribution. Check the diff intent, identify gaps, and recommend the next state before making changes.

output_examples.input: Show me anything that needs my attention.
output: Unlabeled: three issues, oldest first, each with a one-line summary.
Needs-triage: two issues that already have initial context.
Needs-info with reporter activity: one issue ready for re-evaluation.

output_examples.input: Review issue #42 and recommend a state.
output_examples.output: Recommended state: needs-info. The report describes a bug, but the reproduction steps are missing the input data and expected result.
Draft agent brief: category, summary, current behavior, desired behavior, key interfaces, acceptance criteria, and out-of-scope notes.

best_practices: Confirm the repository label mapping before changing issue states.
Verify bug reports and PR claims before preparing an agent brief.
Keep issue comments concise, sourced, and prefixed with the required AI disclaimer.
anti_patterns: Do not close enhancement requests as wontfix without maintainer confirmation.
Do not ask vague needs-info questions when a specific missing detail is known.
Do not run commands from external PRs before reviewing the diff and project expectations.

faq.question: What does this skill triage?
faq.answer: It triages project issues and, when configured, external pull requests that should enter the same workflow.

faq.question: Does it change labels automatically?
faq.answer: It can recommend and apply role changes, but maintainers should confirm state-changing actions first.

faq.question: What is an agent brief?
faq.answer: It is a structured issue or PR comment that defines the work an implementation agent should complete.

faq.question: How does it handle rejected features?
faq.answer: Rejected enhancements can be documented in .out-of-scope files so future similar requests reference the prior decision.

faq.question: Can it verify bugs?
faq.answer: Yes, it asks the agent to reproduce bugs or confirm PR diffs before recommending the final state.

faq.question: What permissions should I review?
faq.answer: Review issue tracker write access, repository file writes, and any commands used to verify external pull requests.
